narrative.overview: An editorial website with generous room around concise instructions, confident serif headlines, and quiet sans-serif detail. Flat paper, clay and green fields carry real app screenshots rather than decorative imagery. This is the website's visual system, not a redesign of the desktop app.
keyCharacteristics: Serif headlines and restrained sans-serif body text.
Real app imagery and direct installation actions.

rules.name: The One Action Rule
rules.body: Use vermilion for the action or emphasis that should lead a group.

rules.name: The Quiet Detail Rule
rules.body: Put product facts in readable body text, not promotional labels above headings.

dos: Do show actual app screenshots with descriptive alternate text.
Do use flat fields and consistent spacing to separate information.
Do keep focus indicators and reduced-motion behavior.
donts: Don't fabricate release availability, customer metrics or statistics.
Don't replace product evidence with decorative card grids.
Don't apply this website's system to the native desktop UI.
